products.name: Case Submission
products.descriptionHtml:
Documents prepared. Next steps coordinated.

You’ve already agreed on the important terms.

File Assist helps turn those decisions into organised documents — and gives you a dedicated coordinator to help keep the next steps moving.

Complete the guided questionnaire and tell us what both of you have agreed. CLEAR CLOSURE prepares the applicable documents for your review.

Your case coordinator then helps keep the practical side organised — from missing information and signatures to filing preparation and administrative follow-up.

File Assist helps coordinate what comes next, so you do not have to manage every practical step alone.

products.name: Guided Resolution
products.descriptionHtml:
Work through what is unresolved. Document what you agree.

You both want to move forward peacefully, but there are still a few important things to work through.

Guided Resolution gives you a structured way to discuss those issues, find common ground, and turn what you agree into clear documentation.

You receive the documentation and coordination included with File Assist, together with up to 4 guided-resolution sessions to help both of you work through unresolved terms.

If agreement is reached, CLEAR CLOSURE helps carry those agreed decisions forward into document preparation, review, signatures, and filing coordination.

The goal is to help you find a workable path forward — not to force either person to accept a settlement.

products.name: Kiosk
products.descriptionHtml:
Put your location to work.

You already have the place.

A shop. An office. A store. A reception. Somewhere people already walk in, wait, ask questions, or look for something useful.

Kiosk turns that location into a WECARE.DIGITAL digital touchpoint.

Install the Android kiosk where visitors can comfortably use it to explore available WECARE.DIGITAL products and services.

When genuine eligible business is generated through your Kiosk and qualifies under the applicable Kiosk terms, you can earn commission.

You do not need to personally make every introduction.

Your location stays there. Your Kiosk can too.

products.name: Paperwork
products.descriptionHtml:
Turn what you’ve agreed into clear, organised documentation.

When the important decisions are already substantially agreed, Paperwork helps you turn those decisions into clear, organised divorce documentation — one step at a time.

Answer a guided set of questions and tell us what both of you have agreed.

CLEAR CLOSURE prepares the applicable documents for your review. You check the details carefully, complete the required signatures, and then manage filing yourself or through an independent advocate.

Paperwork helps with documentation. It does not negotiate disagreements or represent you in court.

products.name: Referral
products.descriptionHtml:
Make the introductions you already make count.

Someone asks you:

“Do you know someone who can help with this?”

You probably already have these conversations with clients, customers, businesses, friends, or people in your network.

Usually, you make the introduction and your part ends there.

Referral Partner gives the right introductions a way to create value for you too.

Join for a one-time ₹999 enrollment. We activate your Referral Partner account and send your unique referral code and getting-started details to you on WhatsApp.

When you meet someone who could genuinely benefit from a WECARE.DIGITAL product or service, introduce them to us.

If that referral becomes qualifying business, you earn according to the applicable Referral Partner terms.

You bring the customer. WECARE.DIGITAL takes it from there.
